title: Quiz: Python HTTPX: Making HTTP Requests With HTTPX2
description: Test your knowledge of Python HTTPX2 by reusing clients, sending async requests, setting timeouts, streaming responses, and enabling HTTP/2.
summary: In this quiz, you’ll test your understanding of Python HTTPX: Making HTTP Requests With HTTPX2 . By working through this quiz, you’ll revisit how to reuse connections with a Client , send concurrent requests with AsyncClient , handle timeouts and errors, stream large responses, and enable HTTP/2.
takeaways: HTTPX2 is Pydantic’s fork of the original HTTPX project, and it keeps the Requests-style API that you may already know.
